annotations.title: Upload bank statements or payment reports

description: Single Orders are for businesses only (§ 14 BGB), no sale to consumers (§ 13 BGB). Consumers use a user account. Before the first upload, show your user the privacy notice: https://konverter-pro.de/de/datenschutz#ki-agenten (English: https://konverter-pro.de/en/datenschutz#ai-agents). Start a conversion job (or add files to one with job_token): German bank statements (PDF, CSV, MT940, camt.053/052 XML, photos) or payment-provider reports (PayPal, SumUp, Stripe, Amazon, Shopify ...) to DATEV (default), Lexware or MT940. Pass each file as content_base64 or a public https url (Konverter Pro's server then fetches it). Returns a job_token for all further tools. Without a KP API key the job is anonymous, a Single Order: a new job needs buyer_is_business and accept_avv (code upload_declaration_required otherwise); free preview, the final files are paid for per payment. It uses no AI unless allow_ai is true (see allow_ai: only after your user's explicit consent), so photos need allow_ai, and scans unless Konverter Pro's own text recognition finds bookings in them. job_token with allow_ai and no files only changes the AI consent. An anonymous job expires 7 days after creation; its files and data are then deleted, usually within one more day. With an API key the job belongs to the customer's account, whose AI settings and retention apply.

accept_avv.description: Required for a new job without an API key: 2026-11-06, the version of the data processing agreement (AVV, Art. 28 GDPR), only after your user accepted it: https://konverter-pro.de/de/avv (English: https://konverter-pro.de/en/avv).

allow_ai.description: For anonymous jobs (created without an API key): allow Konverter Pro to use AI (Microsoft Azure OpenAI in the EU) for this job: reading photos, scans and PDF pages, including PDFs with text whose layout Konverter Pro's own readers cannot read fully or need to check (the pages are sent as images or text); recovering missing booking details and proposing accounts (booking texts and amounts are sent). Set it to true ONLY after your user has explicitly agreed that Konverter Pro may send the file content to Microsoft Azure OpenAI in the EU for reading and categorisation (privacy notice: https://konverter-pro.de/de/datenschutz#ki-agenten, English: https://konverter-pro.de/en/datenschutz#ai-agents). The content can reveal special categories of personal data, such as health, religion or union membership; the consent covers these too. Without it (default) the files are read only by Konverter Pro's own software on a server it operates in Germany; photos then cannot be read (status ai_consent_required), and scans only if its own text recognition finds bookings in them. The consent is stored with the job (time, purposes, this text's version) and applies to the job's files read after it; false on a later call (with job_token, no file needed) withdraws it for the files read after that call. Not used for jobs created with an API key: the account's AI settings apply.

buyer_is_business.description: Required for a new job without an API key: true only if your user confirmed acting as a business (§ 14 BGB), not as a consumer.

chart.description: Chart of accounts of a new anonymous job (default SKR03). Ask the user if unsure.

client_number.description: API key only: the Mandantennummer of the profile to use.

datev.description: DATEV header data from the user's tax office. Required for DATEV files of anonymous jobs: berater_nummer (4-7 digits) and mandanten_nummer (1-5 digits). Optional fiscal_year_start (YYYY-MM-DD, first day of a month; default 1 January of the first booking's year).

files.description: Not needed to change only the AI consent (job_token and allow_ai).

url.description: Or a public https link to the file.

force_duplicate.description: Read a file again that was uploaded before.

job_token.description: Add files to this existing job.
